# widgetlint — full rule catalog

Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- gen-docs`; never edit by hand.

---

# TGW001 — raw HTML exceeds 32768 bytes

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity | `error` |
| Confidence | `certain` |
| Category | Size |

remove markup or shorten text; the server refuses oversized widgets

Spec: <https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets#limits>

---

# TGW002 — compressed size exceeds 4096 bytes

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity | `error` |
| Confidence | `certain` |
| Category | Size |

use size --breakdown: the most expensive parts are usually script and style

Spec: <https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets#counting-the-size>

---

# TGW003 — compressed size exceeds the soft budget

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity | `warn` |
| Confidence | `certain` |
| Category | Size |

the documentation recommends aiming for 3800 bytes after compression

Spec: <https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets#writing-widgets-with-an-llm>

---

# TGW004 — invalid UTF-8 or a NUL character in the input

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity | `error` |
| Confidence | `certain` |
| Category | Size |

save the widget as UTF-8 without a byte-order mark or NUL bytes

Spec: <https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets#limits>

---

# TGW005 — compressed size is within 64 bytes of the hard limit

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity | `info` |
| Confidence | `certain` |
| Category | Size |

zlib builds differ by tens of bytes near the limit; trust the Python reference

Spec: <https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets#counting-the-size>

| Field | Value |
|---|---|

Spec: <https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets#limits>
